Executable local test proves an outer local SOQL bind remains visible inside System.runAs(User); zero Salesforce parity is claimed.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeSystemRunAsLocalTest { @isTest static void preservesOuterQueryBind() { Account seeded = new Account(Name = 'RunAs Local'); insert seeded; String accountName = seeded.Name; User testUser = new User(Id = '005-runas-user'); System.runAs(testUser) { List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = :accountName]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(seeded.Id, rows[0].Id); } } }

salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves only deterministic local System.runAs(User) scope and grants zero Salesforce parity.
